questions.question: What did Job complain about in chapter 24?
options: That his closest friends had all abandoned him
That the harsh weather had wholly ruined all of his crops
That God does not seem to set times to judge the wicked
That his failing health would never again recover
questions.answer: That God does not seem to set times to judge the wicked

questions.question: What wicked deeds did Job describe?
options: Speaking many lies in the courtroom and bribing all of the judges
Bowing down to idols and offering their children in fire
Waging unjust wars and plundering far-off distant cities
Moving boundary stones, oppressing the poor, murder, and theft
questions.answer: Moving boundary stones, oppressing the poor, murder, and theft

questions.question: Job observed that the wicked seem to go unpunished for a time.
Job said the murderer rises in the dark to kill the poor and _____.
Job said the adulterer waits for the _____, disguising his face.
